summary: New since midday, from Ripple Swell 2026: BNY to custody XRP and RLUSD (plus direct RLUSD minting for BNY clients and tokenised trade finance on XRPL), and Ripple partnering with Robinhood to put RLUSD on Robinhood Chain/Bitstamp/app and settle institutionally on the XRP Ledger. XRP ETFs saw small outflows on 26 Oct. Price only +2.5% in 24h, so the news is not yet chased. Buzz roughly double its 3-day average (conference-driven).
catalyst_note: Ripple Swell 27 Oct: BNY custody for XRP/RLUSD; Ripple x Robinhood RLUSD partnership
